_readme: Fill in anything NEEDS_DATA.md reports as missing, then rerun:
Values here override the automated sources and are never overwritten.
Models are keyed by the exact model name shown in Table 1.
Studies are keyed by DOI (no https://doi.org/ prefix).
metrics entries are [label, value, unit]; use "" for a dimensionless unit.
Set sort_value to the number you want the row ranked by (accuracy %, or 100 - error %).

10.1038/s41586-025-08628-5.notes: Example row, kept as a template. Target 200 GPa, measured 158 +/- 11 GPa.
